239.title: Engineering Internships 2027
239.description:
ABOUT NABLA

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.


EARLY CAREERS: SOFTWARE ENGINEERING & MACHINE LEARNING 

We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill.

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible)

Commitment:  Internship-to-hire

What we Offer

 - Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products.

 - Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together.

 - Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter.

 - Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients

 - Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly.

We work across multiple domains:

 - Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX

 - Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs

 - Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems

Your DNA

 - Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field.

 - Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.

 - Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features.

 - Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn.

 - Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow.


NICE-TO-HAVES (BUT NOT REQUIRED)

 - Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems.

 - Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure.

 - Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing.

You’ll see us on campus at:

 - Télécom Paris

 - Forum Trium

 - ENSIMAG

 - CentraleSupélec

 - École Polytechnique

 - EPFL

 - Forum Organisation

Meet us there and tell us what excites you.


LIFE AT NABLA

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. 

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from

5799.title: Applied Science Intern
5799.description: As an Applied Science Intern, you will join a cross-functional team of engineers and applied scientists building AI-powered features within the Datadog platform. You will contribute to both existing and new products by improving machine learning models, developing new AI capabilities, and helping bring research into production. Working closely with engineering and product partners, you'll gain hands-on experience deploying AI systems at scale while strengthening your product mindset, collaboration, and communication skills. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that directly powers customer-facing features. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. What You’ll Do: Design solutions for AI use cases by researching and benchmarking state-of-the-art models to identify the best approach Build highly scalable product features using generative AI, machine learning algorithms, and statistical techniques Contribute to the development, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of production AI models, services, and infrastructure Explore, analyze, and derive insights from the large-scale observability data flowing through Datadog systems Participate in technical knowledge sharing by presenting recent academic research and investigating emerging model architectures to improve existing and future products Collaborate with engineering and product teams to productionize AI solutions and deliver customer-facing features Who You Are: You will graduate in 2027 with a degree in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field You have experience building machine learning models through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects You have strong programming skills and are eager to learn new languages and technologies You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences You have a strong interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven product development Available to complete a 6-month internship beginning in February, March, April, May, or June 2027 (we are unable to accommodate internships starting at any other time) Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply. Benefits and Growth: Work on meaningful technical challenges alongside engineers across the globe Participate in mentorship and buddy programs designed to support learning and development Join an in-person intern cohort, attend company social events, and engage with Datadog Community Guilds and employee resource groups throughout the internship Receive relocation support and

8638.title: Solutions Engineer Intern 2027 (USA)
8638.description: About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . Solutions Engineer Interns work at the intersection of engineering, data and Pinterest’s advertising and revenue ecosystem. They contribute to scoped technical projects that improve tools, workflows, integrations and support experiences for internal teams, advertisers and partners. The role offers exposure to real engineering work, cross-functional collaboration and responsible AI-assisted workflows, including applying judgment and verification to AI-supported work. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to see how technology drives customer and business impact. You’ll partner with engineers, data and analytics specialists, product stakeholders and go-to-market teams; learn how ambiguous operational problems become reliable technical solutions; and gain hands-on experience across coding, debugging, data analysis, automation, documentation and system design. What you’ll do: Complete assigned technical projects with attention to quality, incorporating feedback from your mentor, manager and peers Execute scoped technical tasks end-to-end that contribute to Pinterest products and infrastructure Build, test, debug, and improve code, scripts, automations, internal tools or data workflows using guidance from experienced engineers. Investigate technical issues using logs, data, documentation and structured troubleshooting; help identify root causes, validate solutions and communicate findings. Participate in scheduled engineering on-call coverage during regular workdays and working hours, with guidance from experienced engineers, to help triage and document issues. Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales, Operations and Support teams and, where relevant, communicate directly with external partners to understand requirements, clarify technical questions and contribute to practical solutions. 11192.description: Shift delivers AI agents that transform insurers' most critical work. By combining deep industry expertise and unmatched data resources, Shift provides proven results that have earned the trust of hundreds of the world's leading insurers. Our insurance-grade AI is accurate, explainable, and secure—empowering human experts to move with unmatched speed, total confidence, and a renewed focus on the people they serve. Your browser does not support the video tag. Our culture is built on innovation, trust, and a drive to transform the insurance industry through our SaaS platform. We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance. Learn more at www.shift-technology.com Shift Technology : Shift is the leading AI platform for insurance. Shift combines generative, agentic, and predictive AI to detect fraud, assess risk, and recommend actions throughout the claims process. Our teams tackle complex data challenges and bring advanced models into production at scale, giving insurers deeper insights into their data while helping their customers get paid faster and enjoy a smoother claims experience. Our technology is adopted and trusted by the world’s leading insurers. The QA Engineering Team 🧪: The Quality Assurance team, part of Engineering, makes sure that Shift can ship fast and safely. Our AI-driven software is deployed for insurers worldwide, across many multi-tenant environments, and we use Generative AI, LLM agents, and modern automation to solve quality challenges at this scale. Here are just a few of the areas we work on: Release validation: risk-based testing and delivery automation; Automated regression suites and test automation; Functional test coverage and test gap analysis; Test data generation and test environment provisioning; AI-powered QA tooling, built with LLMs and agents, that engineers and QA leads use every day Working with Engineering teams and QA leads, we replace manual QA effort with intelligent tooling, and we measure the time it saves. Your key responsibilities🧑‍💻: You’ll own an end-to-end project that moves a real QA bottleneck from manual effort to intelligent tooling. You will build something the QA engineering teams use in their day-to-day work, not a proof of concept that stays on a shelf. Your subject will be defined with you during the selection process, within one of these example missions: AI-driven release validation: build a “release copilot” that analyzes release tickets and code changes to compute risk scores and generate risk-based test plans. It also helps run bug bash sessions (scope, assignment, triage, duplicate detection) and drafts test reports and release notes. Functional coverage and test gap analysis: use code intelligence and LLMs to detect shipped features, feature flags, and endpoints, map them against environment configurations and automated regression suites, and show untested areas in a live coverage dashboard.
